message: I'm so glad you're open to learning about transgender issues, Jane. It's been quite a journey for me.
The support from Inclusivity Innovations has been incredible during my transition. They've set a great example.
It's important to have access to proper medical care. My hormone therapy has been a critical part of my transition.
Not many people understand the struggles with gender dysphoria, but talking about it openly has been therapeutic for me.
I had my gender-affirming surgery last month, which was a huge step for me. Recovery is tough, but I'm feeling hopeful.
I appreciate you being there for me, Jane. It means a lot to have friends who support you through such a personal journey.
Did you see the latest news about transgender rights? It's a small step forward, but we still have a long way to go.
Remember, if you ever want to talk more about this, I'm here. It's a complex topic, and I'm still learning too.
